text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Whew, haah... Well, that about wraps it up~.
I'm glad we had another fun run today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Cinemagun captured it clearly.
Wonder Acute's smile, and her data.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And there was one more thing caught in sight.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see... So this is it...
Today felt... completely different from usual...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't take my eyes off Accu-san for a second!
How she'd make her move, the split-second tactics, the decisions, and then—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"A shifting race development! Nothing can be predicted.
And because it can't be read... it's so much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This is... this is what racing truly is...
Hehe, hehehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend looked pleased.
It seemed she was able to catch a faint glimpse of that thrill she had been chasing after.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Accu-san.
Having an opponent who truly stands out really takes a race to a whole 'nother level, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, I have a special favor to ask~.
How about we become each other's number one rival from now on?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Having someone like that makes things go a lot smoother anyway.
...What do ya say?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Her number one rival... That's an extremely
flattering thing to hear, but...

text_block_list.name: Rickey & Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Ricky-chan and
Tarumae-chan...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. Ya see, there's a girl
who told me, "Wait for me, 'cause I'm
definitely gonna be your rival!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, you two~.
Yes, yes, I'm coming right now. Just a moment, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Acute-chan--!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The recruitment failed.
It seems Wonder Acute already had a prior engagement.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I was too naive. Since we're from the same class, I really thought she'd say yes without a second thought.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Still, now I'm certain. To get that real thrill,
I just have to run against strong Umamusume after all.
choice_data_list: Yeah, there's no doubt about that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A clash of titan against titan.
It is precisely a contest of such high caliber that produces unexpected thrills.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "For that purpose, Transcend must become stronger, and she must also run against strong opponents."
choice_data_list: Tran, who do you want to race next?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I've got some prospects in mind.
There are multiple candidates though, so first—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Let's review the current power dynamics in the dirt division. Aaaand... click!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, three horse girls are taking the dirt world by storm.
Namely, those three are—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "First is Espoir City. Currently running rampant on dirt tracks with 5 GⅠ wins."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Next is Furioso.
As everyone knows, she's an exchange student from the NAR's Funabashi, and she's won the GⅠ Teio Sho.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And the one who's said to have grown
by leaps and bounds recently is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon. Calling herself an Umamusume idol—an Umadol—
she has claimed front-running victories in numerous graded races.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Their records may differ, but in terms of sheer ability, they're on par. All of them are immensely strong, and...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, every single one of them
is an opponent that gets my blood pumping.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If I could run with all three of them
and capture it all on Cinemagunâ
choice_data_list: The wonderful database is finally complete.
The wonderful database is finally complete, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And all that accumulated data will be the key to leading us to paradise.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"It's the key to achieving
a truly thrilling run, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hearing the explanation, I nod firmly. Racing against these three is something I must do, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three strongest active dirt Umamusume.
Once the analysis of their running is complete,
Transcend will surely—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy, who should we run with first?
Falco-chan and Furio's next race hasn't
been decided yet...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Espon... Espoir City's next race has been decided, but there's a problem...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Believe it or not, Espo-n's next race
is the GⅠ Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Even among Dirt GⅠs, this race gets a huuuuge
amount of attention, so for me right now...
it'd probably be super tough."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Transcend said,
the Champions Cup held in December
was no ordinary dirt GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of only two JRA Dirt GⅠ races.
Along with February's 'February Stakes', it is a massive race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for a GⅠ really is quite a high hurdle.
Her opponents are tough, and an uphill battle is inevitable, but—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh... Shivers?
choice_data_list: Yeah. If you were to seize that crown...
Yeah. If I could actually win that crown...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: To win the crown of glory...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You mean not only run alongside Espo,
but actually aim for the title too?
choice_data_list: Yeah, so we can push each other to even greater heights!
Yeah, so we can keep pushing each other to greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Transcend is in the position of the pursuer.
But if she can win the Champions Cup,
her rivals will—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They'll be much more aware that "a formidable new rival has appeared!"
And I had a feeling that would lead to even greater thrills.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Winning the Champions Cup
to make an impression, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying I gotta promote myself like,
"I'm gonna break into the Big Three!"?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm, as expected of Trai-chan. Not only are you bold, but you're getting pretty savvy with information warfare too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then let's enter. Not just to get
intel on Espo-n, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
By winning, we'll plant the idea in everyone's minds
that our team is actually amazing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the first battle for collecting data on the Big Three suddenly turned into a major climax.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the upcoming Champions Cup,
will Transcend's strength truly be enough
to overcome Espoir City?
